notes:
Summary: Late-stage enterprise deal stalled and likely closed-lost. Primary technical blocker: latency SLO not met during dedicated POC. Target: p95 end-to-end <400ms for 1–2 turn chat; observed p95 ranged 1.1s–1.9s for common flows. Streaming behavior: chunk gaps between 200–800ms, resulting in perceived UI stalls. Root causes identified in POC:
- Cold-start time on warm pools higher than expected (warmup/prefill not compensating for large KV cache loads).
- Quantized 13B variant exhibited longer decode wall-time on the customer’s workload distribution vs. our test harness.
- Continuous batching during peak caused sporadic queuing spikes; p95 sensitive to short spikes from 95th-percentile queuing.
- Browser-side reassembly of stream events exposed intermittent dropped frames when chunk latency >250ms.

What we tried:
- Tuned batching config (min_batch_ms, max_batch_tokens) — reduced throughput but still missed p95.
- Enabled prefix/KV caching for common prompts — helped mean latency but p95 remained high under burst.
- Proposed a dedicated burst pool and kernel tuning — needed deeper infra change and longer rollout.

Customer sentiment: frustrated but constructive. Quote from product lead: "Great accuracy, but if the chat stutters our claims agents won't adopt it — latency is a showstopper." Procurement signs: budget freeze after leadership re-org; internal champion (director of automation) moved to global ops.

Why lost (current view): combination of strict latency requirement, competitive vendor promising edge/closer-to-user inference, and internal org churn leading to deprioritization. Security/compliance was not the blocker — they accepted our controls — it's purely technical SLA + budget timing.

Follow-ups / playbook notes:
- Keep the relationship warm: quarterly check-ins; share low-level perf investigations and RFC when kernel/serving improvements land.
- Offer a scoped rescue POC: single-region edge proxies + single-model small-quantized variant with dedicated burst nodes; explicit p95 acceptance criteria and short SLA credit.
- Re-engage once champion resurfaces or after Q2 budget window.

Stubs/links: see Drive deck and security doc, Fireflies demos, Jira RDWD-7890 (POC perf logs) for attachable artifacts.
